title: ChatLimits attachment count u32 vs wire u64
description: From batch-5 verify of y3f2.5 (e409ff97). ChatLimits::max_attachments_per_message is u32 but ChatCapability::max_attachments_per_message (chat-types capability.rs:89) and the spec UnsignedInt are u64. Changing a pub field type after 0.4 is breaking. Fix: make it u64 (and check sibling ChatLimits fields against their capability counterparts).
close_reason: Landed in 7ff76337 fix(chat-server): attachment count cap is u64 (batch 6, adversarially verified, CI green at a586c251)
